objective: Install the built HolyAgent Pi extension from working PR #130 and verify Pi recognizes and loads it.
scope: Install from PR branch release/0.3.4/feat/final-guidance-events using the documented Pi package install path.
Operate on the user-level Pi installation and settings only; do not change repository files or branches.
Run installation and verification now and report exact commands, exit codes and installed source.
constraints: The user explicitly requested installation, so the global pi install and its settings change are approved.
Use gh if further PR metadata is needed; PR #130 head 765aa8b22e6288fdd680a564e04389e2a6274462 is the selected source because it alone carries the newer built extensions/holyagent.js.

Prefer the documented command: pi install git:github.com/davidbasilefilho/holyagent@release/0.3.4/feat/final-guidance-events. If that source shape is rejected, inspect the documented package-root syntax and use the equivalent PR-branch dist package source; do not switch the repository checkout.
Use provider kimi-coding and model kimi-for-coding for every Pi model invocation.
Preserve packages/integrations/pi/dist/extensions/.pi/ and every unrelated repository or user file.
Verify with pi list and a headless extension load using the requested model. Ensure the load check exercises the installed PR #130 extension rather than only the older main-checkout bundle.
Keep working until installation and verification are complete; stop only for an unresolvable install error. Do not commit, push, open PRs, or start extra work.
Report in under 300 words; put long logs outside the repository and give their paths.

criteria.text: Installation: the user-level Pi configuration installs the HolyAgent package from PR #130 and contains the newer built extension.
Verification: pi list exits 0 and shows the installed PR source, and a headless Pi invocation with provider kimi-coding and model kimi-for-coding loads the installed extension successfully.
Scope: no repository files, branches, commits or unrelated Pi settings are changed, and the existing dist/extensions/.pi path is preserved.
